features.title: Administration and Versioned Reference Data
features.overview: Mill Administrator maintains customer/account grants, facilities/equipment/capacities, operational master data, balance policies and effective-dated published MRL versions. These are administrative commands with distinct validation policies.
rules: Reuse this command structure for UC-01–UC-05 with entity-specific policies; publishing MRLs is not permission to set customer safety margins (UC-22).
Equipment locations belong to the same facility. Capacity always includes units; silo-compartment capacity is kg.
One compartment has at most one active owner occupancy. Clear only after zero stock and recorded clearance.
Changing grants does not permit editing accepted events or historical policy versions.

features.title: Procurement, Field Capture and Offline Synchronization
features.overview: Capture company-scoped farmer/plot/season records, declarations, positive intake lines and sample/handover references. Offline capture retains records locally; the server independently accepts each submitted operation.
seqs: Measure and review complete physical arrival
rules: UC-07/08/10 reuse the scoped acceptance pattern with field-record/declaration/sample validation; only UC-09 creates receipt stock. Sampling is optional.
Submit dependencies in order (farmer/plot/season before dependent receipts; receipt before sample); a missing prerequisite remains visible for reconciliation.
A stable operation ID identifies one command, not a whole arbitrary offline batch. Same-key changed data never creates a second receipt.
The transaction adapter must use a savepoint or validate-before-write path to retain rejected submissions without retaining partial stock writes.

features.title: Physical Operations, Approved Execution and Stock Inspection
features.overview: A shared ledger acceptance contract handles processing and unchanged-lot transfers. Plan execution additionally requires current scope and matching INPUT reservations. Stock and source composition are read models of committed history.
seqs: Validate and atomically post conversion or transfer
Execute approved plan scope with target reservations
rules: For conversion inputs I, outputs O and declared loss L: v = I − O − L; allowed = I × tolerance_value / 100. Require I > 0, positive inputs/outputs, L ≥ 0 and abs(v) ≤ allowed. Nonzero v needs a Mill Manager reason/confirmation.
Variance is signed reconciliation information, never usable stock and never automatically reclassified as declared loss. Out-of-tolerance input is rejected.

Attribute output o to input i as output_kg(o) × input_kg(i) / total_input_kg. Round down at the chosen kg precision and assign residual by largest fractional remainder, tie by input_id. Each output attribution sums exactly to its mass. No cycles.
Transfers preserve lot identity and equal mass at two allocations; physical mixing uses a conversion. A loss-only write-off is outside the baseline.
on_hand = sum committed movement deltas. outstanding = RESERVE − (CONSUME − REVERSE_CONSUME) − RELEASE. free = on_hand − outstanding. Stock inspection never grants posting authority.

Missing residue evidence alone does not invalidate a physically valid posting; confirmed risk restrictions and HOLD still apply. Plan execution uses current authority and exact INPUT reservations; standalone conversion may use only free stock.

features.title: Reconciled Operation Correction
features.overview: Request, physical reconciliation and atomic compensation/replacement are separate interactions. A correction lock protects remaining original output stock while evidence is investigated.
rules: No standalone compensation or automatic downstream rollback. BLOCKED_DOWNSTREAM keeps investigation and restrictions on relevant remaining stock.

Replacement and compensation are different IDs of the same company; both commit with projection/lineage changes. Historical lineage remains; current lineage uses replacement, without reverse physical edges.
REVERSE_CONSUME fully reverses one original INPUT CONSUME once; it is not RESERVE. Loading OUTPUT consumption is not reversed by this processing-correction workflow.

Reuse Section 3.3 validation. Retaining the original plan requires unchanged compatible content, current review and exact reservation quota; otherwise replace outside the old plan and require new export authority.

features.title: Laboratory Evidence, Residue Bounds and Current Compliance
features.overview: Maintain laboratory history and customer margin versions, select eligible evidence, propagate supported upper bounds and assess the current decision scope. Bound calculation is deterministic evidence processing, not AI prediction.
seqs: Late evidence and affected unfinished authority
rules: LAB follows the supplied Sample → PaddyLot model. Any direct laboratory sampling model for processed rice requires an explicit schema decision; it is not silently added here.

COHORT needs exact recorded membership and matching company/site/season/window, immutable membership snapshot and supported per-substance bound. An observed maximum alone is not a validated operational upper bound.

CONVERSION uses actual input quantities and bounds for every input, with supported substance/stage/output-commodity propagation. Never assume factor 1 or a milling reduction. Missing rule gives INCOMPLETE for compliance but need not prevent valid physical recording.
Compatible-basis blends with a supported rule use U(s) = sum(m_i × U_i(s)) / sum(m_i). Quality aggregation is attribute-specific, not universally weighted.

RELATIVE threshold T = MRL × (1 − r), 0 ≤ r < 1. ABSOLUTE threshold T = MRL − a, a ≥ 0 in compatible units. A negative threshold cannot be passed by nonnegative residue bounds. No default operational margin is introduced.
Required panel is recorded explicitly; missing limit never means unlimited. MRL must be published, effective and known at decision time. Unresolved independent lab conflicts block PASS.

UC-22 reuses the versioned configuration pattern in Section 3.1 with Customer Manager scope. UC-21 reuses registration with same-context official supersession checks. Historical assessments are never rewritten.

features.title: Export Orders, Blend Proposal and Plan Review
features.overview: Create owner-scoped orders/container targets and versioned specifications, search for a feasible proposal, and review the exact current execution scope. Proposal generation neither consumes stock nor grants loading authority.
rules: Approve only current PASS, with a new PlanReview referencing purpose REVIEW. If a non-PASS approval is refused, retain the assessment/findings; do not record a false APPROVE review.
Only one plan has active new execution/loading authority per container. Evidence/stock/HOLD changes stale unfinished authority and release unconsumed reservations without erasing committed execution.
OUTPUT_ONLY names existing output stock and never asks spent inputs to remain available. Re-review of unchanged P1 output stays on P1; new P2 content excludes already produced/loaded P1 output.
The chosen search implementation, budget and candidate-order strategy are implementation decisions still to be confirmed. No MILP, IIS or optimality guarantee is assumed.
Physical execution refers to Section 3.3, current assessment to Section 3.5 and reservation correction to Section 3.4.

features.title: Container Loading, CLOSE and Shipment Documentation
features.overview: Loading withdraws the exact approved output stock; CLOSE reassesses every committed loading across plan versions. Documentation preserves the unique successful whole-container closing snapshot.
seqs: Record loading from the approved plan output
Close the complete container across plan versions
Retrieve dossier and append later evidence
rules: Loading, metadata and CLOSE are separate outcomes. Updating a seal number does not post stock or close a container.

CLOSE scope is container-wide: container_id required; plan_id and loading_id NULL. Its basis includes every committed loading and historical authorization, even when P1 no longer has new-loading authority.
Require total loaded mass exactly target_mass_kg and sum completed-container mass ≤ order.required_mass_kg. No processing tolerance applies to shipment quantity.
Commit PASS CLOSE assessment, CLOSED state and unique dossier atomically. After CLOSE, new evidence becomes a supplement; retrieval never regenerates the closing snapshot.

Store immutable snapshot bytes transactionally for the initial design, or persist content durably before committing its database reference; unreferenced prepared content is harmless and cannot authorize CLOSE. No successful dossier may refer to missing content.
UC-33 shares DocumentService access/versioning structure; exports persist document type/version/file reference. This does not add a buyer portal, EPCIS integration or customs authorization.

features.title: Bidirectional Traceability, HOLD and Retained Alerts
features.overview: Trace recorded contributions in both directions. Customer Manager explicitly chooses each lot/container HOLD; scoped in-app notices and operational handling retain the restriction.
seqs: Issue HOLD, retain notices and handle restriction
Issue lot or container HOLD with full target effects
rules: Forward traversal visits every reachable recorded lot/plan/container; backward traversal sums contributions from all committed container loading. Results describe accounting shares, not identified grains.
UC-25 allows Customer Export Officer to trace affected targets; UC-24 is Customer Manager source-contribution trace. Trace results do not automatically issue HOLD.

HOLD blocks relevant planning/reservation/production consumption/loading/CLOSE; authorized ledgered isolation transfer remains allowed. Acknowledgement, response and read status do not release restrictions.
HOLD and correctly scoped in-app notices commit together; no email/SMS or independent notification service is introduced. Reservation RELEASE is unrelated to HOLD release.

features.title: Business Event Search and History
features.overview: All six internal roles can inspect permitted immutable business events; this shared capability never broadens action grants or inventory visibility.
seqs: Search and inspect permitted business history
rules: Events cover procurement, operations/transfers/corrections, lab registration/supersession, review/reservations, loading/CLOSE, HOLD/handling, administration and traceback.
Retain actor or system cause, typed targets, occurred/recorded times, relevant source versions and deltas/basis. No edit/delete command exists.
Read access through Internal User does not imply stock inspection permission or logging every screen view.

coverage: Manage accounts, roles and facility grants
Capture field and procurement records offline
Inspect owner stock and source composition
Review and approve or reject plan
Trace source contributions to and from containers
Trace affected lots, plans and containers
Create export order and container target

implementation_status.1: Repository-backed foundation: Identity/Catalogs administration, facility configuration and MRL publication exist. The complete target administration contract remains in scope.
implementation_status.2: Mixed: field source registration, procurement idempotency and physical-arrival workflows exist; complete offline capture/sync and sample workflows remain planned. Registration and stock acceptance are separate outcomes.
implementation_status.3: Mixed: physical processing, transfers, stock and source-share history exist through LedgerService/protected SQL; approved export-plan scope and reservations remain planned extensions.
implementation_status.4: Repository-backed processing-correction flow with target accounting extensions. Current code binds reconciliation to current positions and exact replacement content/version. Export reservation reversal integration remains planned.
implementation_status.5: Planned full compliance design. Published MRL maintenance/resolution exists in Catalogs; ledger.evidence is generic operational evidence. Neither implies completed lab/cohort/residue assessment.
implementation_status.6: Planned full export planning/review/reservation design. ExportStaff is a persisted role; its presence does not imply completed order/planner APIs.
implementation_status.7: Planned full container loading/CLOSE/dossier design, retaining all original quantity and assessment requirements.
implementation_status.8: Mixed: explicit lot HOLD, scoped notices/handling and root-source contributions exist. Full source-to-container traversal, container HOLD and downstream authority invalidation remain planned.
implementation_status.9: Mixed: existing scoped ledger.read history and module audit records; combined cross-module export/compliance history is the complete target extension.
